butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Başlangıç, Allah’ın adıyla ve rahmetiyle okumanın ölçüsünü kurar. Sonraki ayetler bu adı, insanların gözü için yükseltilen sahte itibarla karşılaştırınca, besmele soyut bir formül olmaktan çıkar; yetim, yoksul ve küçük fayda karşısında rahmet bağının korunup korunmadığını sınayan bir başlangıç olur. {س م و B005; س م و B008; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B002; ر ء ي B005; م ع ن B005}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Başlangıç, Allah’ın adıyla ve rahmetiyle okumanın ölçüsünü kurar. Sonraki ayetler bu adı, insanların gözü için yükseltilen sahte itibarla karşılaştırınca, besmele soyut bir formül olmaktan çıkar; yetim, yoksul ve küçük fayda karşısında rahmet bağının korunup korunmadığını sınayan bir başlangıç olur.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:1.** أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, dini yalanlayanı görmeye ve tanımaya çağırır. Devamındaki gösteriş ve maunu engelleme, bu yalanlamayı yalnız sözlü inkâr değil, hesap, borç, sorumluluk ve komşuluk faydasını geçersiz sayan yaşanmış bir sahtecilik olarak değiştirir. {ر ء ي B013; ر ء ي B001; ر ء ي B005; ك ذ ب B002; ك ذ ب B004; د ي ن B002; د ي ن B003; م ع ن B005}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, dini yalanlayanı görmeye ve tanımaya çağırır. Devamındaki gösteriş ve maunu engelleme, bu yalanlamayı yalnız sözlü inkâr değil, hesap, borç, sorumluluk ve komşuluk faydasını geçersiz sayan yaşanmış bir sahtecilik olarak değiştirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:2.** فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ — Birincil okuma: Bu kişi yetimi sertçe iter; koruyucusundan kopmuş çocuğu daha da dışarı sürer. Son ayetteki engelleme ve ev-içi fayda alanı bu itmeyi bedensel kabalıktan öteye taşır: yetim, hane, bakım ve hakkına erişimden bariyerle ayrılan kişi hâline gelir. {د ع ع B001; د ع ع B002; ي ت م B001; ي ت م B002; ي ت م B004; م ن ع B002; س ك ن B003; م ع ن B006}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:3.** وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, yoksulun yemeğine teşvik etmeyen kişiyi gösterir. Bütün bağlam, bunu sadece yemek vermemek değil, toplumdaki besin, geçim, borç ve küçük yardımların akışını harekete geçirmemek olarak değiştirir; miskin yerleşme, sakinleşme ve onurlu durma imkânından mahrum bırakılır. {ح ض ض B001; ح ض ض B002; ط ع م B002; ط ع م B004; س ك ن B006; س ك ن B010; د ي ن B003; م ع ن B005}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:4.** فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ — Birincil okuma: Uyarı, namaz kılanlara yönelir; fakat hedef namazın kendisi değil, merhametten kopmuş namaz kimliğidir. Önceki yetim ve miskin sahneleriyle sonraki gaflet ve gösteriş birleşince, salât rahmet kanalından statü tuzağına ve hatta azap ateşini çağrıştıran ters bir delile dönüşür. {ص ل و B003; ص ل و B002; ص ل و B001; ص ل و B004; ر ح م B001; ط ع م B002; ر ء ي B005}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:5.** ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ — Birincil okuma: Onlar namazlarından gafildir; kalp ve dikkat namazın gereğinden uzaklaşmıştır. butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:6.** ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ — Birincil okuma: Onlar yaptıklarını insanlara göstermek için yaparlar. İlk ayetteki “gördün mü?” sorusu burada tersine döner: görülmesi istenen kişi, dini görünürlük alanını kendisi için kullanır; Allah’ın adıyla yükselmesi gereken amel, seyircinin gözünde yükselen sahte bir isme dönüşür. {ر ء ي B005; ر ء ي B013; ر ء ي B004; ر ء ي B006; س م و B005; س م و B008; ء ل ه B002}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **107:7.** وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ — Birincil okuma: Onlar maunu, yani küçük ve elde hazır faydayı engellerler. parent_channels.name: Care and Circulation of Sustenance

subchannels.name: Feeding the Vulnerable
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dependent child or poor person is placed before an agent who either thrusts the recipient away or mobilizes food on the recipient's behalf.
subchannels.active_motifs: orphaned child (ي ت م:B001/m01); forceful rebuff (د ع ع:B001/m01); exhortation toward food and good (ح ض ض:B001/m01); food as sustenance (ط ع م:B001/m02); feeding another (ط ع م:B002/m01); poor and humbled recipient (س ك ن:B006/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The orphan and the poor person occupy the recipient role, food is the transferable object, and exhortation is the social action that should set provision in motion. The violent shove reverses that process by turning proximity to a dependent into expulsion.

subchannels.name: Household Aid, Lodging, and Credit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small useful resources circulate through lending, hospitality, charity, and deferred exchange, or are stopped by an owner who keeps them back.
subchannels.active_motifs: domestic utility or loan (م ع ن:B005/m01); small gift or charity (م ع ن:B005/m02); small and light-value thing (م ع ن:B003/m01); free lodging (س ك ن:B002/m02); debt obligation (د ي ن:B003/m01); lending and borrowing (د ي ن:B003/m02); withholding goods and good (م ن ع:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 دِّينِ (د ي ن), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
subchannels.synthesis: A utensil, gift, room, or loan can be modest in scale yet decisive in use. Debt and deferred exchange enlarge the same interpersonal frame: one party has temporary command of a resource, another has a claim upon it, and withholding closes the route by which benefit should return.

subchannels.name: Livelihood That Permits Staying
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water, income, food, and pasture accumulate into a dependable provision base that lets residents remain in one place.
subchannels.active_motifs: well-provisioned livelihood (ط ع م:B004/m01); income source or productive holding (ط ع م:B004/m03); provisions that sustain residence (س ك ن:B010/m01); pasture that prevents migration (س ك ن:B010/m02); flowing visible water (م ع ن:B001/m01); dwelling place (م ع ن:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from available water and productive assets to stored or renewable provision, then to continued residence. Livelihood is not merely possession here; it is the material condition that converts movement into settlement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life-sustaining food, shelter, and useful goods move toward vulnerable recipients through feeding, lending, and shared use, while repulsion and withholding interrupt that movement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 107:2 يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ, 107:3 يَحُضُّ / طَعَامِ / مِسْكِينِ, and 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same circulation frame extends from a meal to free lodging, household loans, credit, and provision that allows a household to remain settled.

parent_channels.name: Worship, Judgment, and Moral Exposure

subchannels.name: Reckoning, Denial, and Doom
subchannels.scene_or_process: A denied judgment culminates in recompense, ruin, and exposure to an ordeal figured as consuming heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: judgment and reckoning (د ي ن:B002/m01); recompense (د ي ن:B002/m02); denial or attribution of falsehood (ك ذ ب:B002/m01); doom and destruction (و ي ل:B001/m01); exposure to heat and ordeal (ص ل و:B001/m03)
subchannels.synthesis: Denial targets the reality of reckoning, but the judgment sense of religion restores an answering event in which acts receive recompense. Woe names the outcome, while the fire sense of the prayer root supplies a concrete image of ordeal.

subchannels.name: Obedience, Prayer, and Blessing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper enters an order of obedience, performs prescribed prayer, and directs blessing or mercy toward another.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedience and submission (د ي ن:B001/m01); creed and worship order (د ي ن:B001/m02); prescribed ritual prayer (ص ل و:B003/m01); prayer and blessing for another (ص ل و:B002/m01); divine mercy and purification (ص ل و:B002/m02); prayer as a source of repose (س ك ن:B004/m01); religious due and obedience (م ع ن:B005/m03)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 دِّينِ (د ي ن), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Obedience supplies the governing relation, ritual prayer supplies the enacted form, and blessing or mercy supplies the outward-directed effect. Prayer can also become a place of inward repose, while the religious-due sense of small aid carries observance into material service.

subchannels.name: Negligent and Ostentatious Observance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ritual action remains publicly visible while attention leaves the act and concern shifts toward the gaze of other people.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed ritual prayer (ص ل و:B003/m01); lapse within prayer (س ه و:B001/m02); general neglect and shortcoming (ي ت م:B003/m01); ostentatious display (ر ء ي:B005/m01); deceptive action (ك ذ ب:B001/m02)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و), 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The body preserves the recognizable form of prayer, but attention has withdrawn and the act is redirected toward spectators. Neglect names the inner absence, ostentation names the social orientation, and deceptive action names the gap between visible observance and operative purpose.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Religious obligation becomes visible through prayer, mercy, and social response, while denial, neglect, and display place the actor before reckoning and consequence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 107:1 دِّينِ / يُكَذِّبُ, 107:4 وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ, 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ, and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Prayer spans ritual performance, blessing, divine mercy, personal solace, and exposure to punitive heat.

parent_channels.name: Visibility, Display, and Readable Signs

subchannels.name: Reflective Inspection and Outward Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer uses direct sight or a mirror to inspect outward form and read what appears on a face or in a visibly flourishing condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory sight (ر ء ي:B001/m01); mirror (ر ء ي:B006/m01); outward beauty and appearance (ر ء ي:B006/m02); facial sign (ر ء ي:B006/m03); mirror presentation (ر ء ي:B012/m02); well-provisioned condition (ط ع م:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م)
subchannels.synthesis: The mirror and the eye form an inspection mechanism: outward form is presented, viewed, and interpreted. A flourishing livelihood can register in appearance, so material condition becomes visible rather than remaining an unseen possession.

subchannels.name: Public Display and Visual Standards
subchannels.scene_or_process: People or groups arrange themselves to be seen, using display, mutual visibility, and raised markers to direct a public gaze.
subchannels.active_motifs: mutual visibility and facing (ر ء ي:B004/m01); ostentatious display (ر ء ي:B005/m01); raised standard or banner (ر ء ي:B011/m01); deliberate showing (ر ء ي:B012/m01); deceptive patterned cloth (ك ذ ب:B009/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب)
subchannels.synthesis: Facing groups establish a field of mutual sight, the banner fixes a visible point within it, and deliberate showing turns action into spectacle. The patterned cloth adds a material warning that visibility can be engineered to present a state other than the underlying one.

subchannels.name: Bodily and Subtle Indicators
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed bodily or environmental state is inferred from a small visible trace.
subchannels.active_motifs: menstrual indication (ر ء ي:B007/m01); visible animal pregnancy (ر ء ي:B010/m01); enlarged udder as gestational sign (ر ء ي:B010/m02); facial indication (ر ء ي:B006/m03); faint overlooked star (س ه و:B005/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و)
subchannels.synthesis: A discharge marker, enlarged udder, facial trace, or tiny star does not display the whole state; it provides a discriminating sign from which that state is known. Seeing therefore includes sustained attention to what is easy to overlook.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sight makes an object, person, or hidden state legible through reflection, public display, or a diagnostic trace.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visuality reaches from mirrors and banners to pregnancy, menstrual indication, facial marks, and barely perceptible celestial signs.

parent_channels.name: Settlement, Sacred Space, and Civic Order

subchannels.name: Household Residence and Storage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Residents inhabit a house whose porch, storage supports, sources of repose, and shared implements make daily life possible.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling and home (س ك ن:B002/m01); residents and household (س ك ن:B003/m01); source of repose (س ك ن:B004/m01); settled place (س ك ن:B009/m01); front porch (س ه و:B004/m01); storage crossbeams (س ه و:B004/m02); domestic utility or loan (م ع ن:B005/m01); dwelling place (م ع ن:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: The house is both enclosure and working system. Residents gather within it, the porch marks its threshold, crossbeams hold goods, and loanable implements move between neighboring interiors without dissolving the settled center.

subchannels.name: Protected Civic and Sacred Center
subchannels.scene_or_process: A town organizes obedience around a house of worship, maintains communal dues, and protects its inhabited territory.
subchannels.active_motifs: city as a seat of obedience (د ي ن:B006/m01); house of worship (ص ل و:B007/m01); fortified place (م ن ع:B003/m02); defensive strength (م ن ع:B003/m01); communal religious due (م ع ن:B005/m03); settled place (س ك ن:B009/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 دِّينِ (د ي ن), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
subchannels.synthesis: Authority, worship, and defense converge in a protected settlement. The worship house gives the town a ritual center, civic obedience supplies order, communal dues circulate benefit, and fortification preserves access to the shared place.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Dwelling becomes communal settlement through domestic structure, worship space, shared utility, authority, and protection.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 107:1 دِّينِ, 107:3 مِسْكِينِ, 107:4-5 مُصَلِّينَ / صَلَاتِهِمْ, 107:5 سَاهُونَ, and 107:7 مَاعُونَ / يَمْنَعُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A porch beam, household loan, temple, fortified town, and civic obedience occupy successive scales of one inhabited order.

parent_channels.name: Plant Gathering, Cultivation, and Preparation

subchannels.name: Watered Pasture and Cattle Feed
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flowing water sustains summer plants and abundant pasture, grazing animals consume the forage, and nourishment appears in bodily fat.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing visible water (م ع ن:B001/m01); summer water plant grazed by cattle (د ع ع:B008/m01); camel forage grass (ص ل و:B009/m01); pasture that prevents migration (س ك ن:B010/m02); livestock fat and marrow condition (ط ع م:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Water produces a grazing zone durable enough to halt migration. Aquatic plants and tufted grass pass into the herd as nourishment, with fat and marrow marking the outcome of successful pasture.

subchannels.name: Famine Seed and Grinding Slab
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wild edible seed is gathered under scarcity and reduced on a broad stone into usable food.
subchannels.active_motifs: wild famine seed (د ع ع:B010/m01); black-ant lookalike (د ع ع:B010/m02); grinding slab (ص ل و:B008/m01); food as sustenance (ط ع م:B001/m02); productive livelihood (ط ع م:B004/m03)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و)
subchannels.synthesis: The seed supplies an emergency food object, its ant-like form aids recognition, and the slab supplies the processing tool. Scarcity thus produces a compact gathering-and-pounding scene rather than an abstract notion of provision.

subchannels.name: Grafting, Ripening, and Fruitful Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: A foreign branch is joined to a tree, the union takes, water sustains growth, and fruit reaches perceptible maturity.
subchannels.active_motifs: graft acceptance (ط ع م:B010/m01); fruit ripening (ط ع م:B005/m01); productive tree or milk yield (ط ع م:B005/m03); flowing irrigation water (م ع ن:B001/m02); sensory inspection (ر ء ي:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Joining is followed by acceptance, growth, and visible yield. The eye verifies the successful union and ripening, while water provides the material continuity between graft and fruit.

subchannels.name: Bitter Medicinal Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bitter resinous substance, including an animal-derived preparation, is gathered and handled as medicine alongside other wild plant materials.
subchannels.active_motifs: bitter medicinal resin (ح ض ض:B003/m01); camel-derived medicinal preparation (ح ض ض:B003/m02); forage plant material (ص ل و:B009/m01); grinding slab (ص ل و:B008/m01); visible inspection of appearance (ر ء ي:B006/m02)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:3 يَحُضُّ (ح ض ض), 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و)
subchannels.synthesis: The medicinal object is defined by bitterness, resinous matter, and an unusual animal-derived ingredient. Plant material and a pounding surface place it within a preparation scene, while visual inspection tracks the material being handled.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water and human handling transform wild or cultivated plant material into pasture, food, or remedy.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 107:2 يَدُعُّ, 107:3 يَحُضُّ / طَعَامِ / مِسْكِينِ, 107:4-5 مُصَلِّينَ / صَلَاتِهِمْ, and 107:7 مَاعُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Food provision opens onto aquatic forage, tufted camel grass, famine seed, graft acceptance, grinding stone, and bitter medicinal resin.

parent_channels.name: Blocking, Capturing, and Defending

subchannels.name: Forceful Exclusion and Reciprocal Struggle
subchannels.scene_or_process: One actor drives another away or toward danger, while opposing force turns unilateral coercion into a contest.
subchannels.active_motifs: forceful shove and rebuff (د ع ع:B001/m01); coercive redirection (د ع ع:B001/m02); battle incitement (ح ض ض:B001/m02); reciprocal resistance (م ن ع:B006/m01); choking restraint (ط ع م:B012/m02); coercive domination (د ي ن:B004/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Shoving, incitement, and throat restraint place force directly on a body. Reciprocal resistance changes the relation from expulsion to struggle, while domination names the durable hierarchy that coercion seeks to produce.

subchannels.name: Trapping and Capture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter marks or watches a field, sets a snare, uses a hunting implement, and stills the captured animal.
subchannels.active_motifs: raised visual standard (ر ء ي:B011/m01); hunting snare (ص ل و:B004/m01); hunting implement or animal that supplies prey (ط ع م:B006/m01); knife (س ك ن:B007/m01); stilling through slaughter (س ك ن:B007/m02); obstacle or barrier (م ن ع:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
subchannels.synthesis: The visible marker organizes the hunting space, the snare and barrier close an escape route, and the bow or trained animal converts capture into food. The knife completes the mechanism by ending the prey's movement.

subchannels.name: Fortification and Protective Strength
subchannels.scene_or_process: A defended place prevents hostile access through enclosure, collective strength, and protective aid.
subchannels.active_motifs: obstacle or barrier (م ن ع:B002/m01); defensive strength (م ن ع:B003/m01); fortified place (م ن ع:B003/m02); protective aid (م ن ع:B003/m03); city as seat of authority (د ي ن:B006/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The barrier supplies the immediate obstruction, the fortress gives it durable spatial form, and collective strength supplies an agent capable of maintaining it. Protective aid turns prevention from private refusal into communal defense.

subchannels.name: Chastity and Guarded Personal Access
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman without a spouse maintains bodily and social boundaries through refusal and guarded access.
subchannels.active_motifs: chaste refusal (م ن ع:B004/m01); woman without a spouse (ي ت م:B005/m01); menstrual indication (ر ء ي:B007/m01); self-directed resolve (ح ض ض:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:3 يَحُضُّ (ح ض ض), 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
subchannels.synthesis: Marital status, bodily indication, and deliberate refusal define a guarded personal sphere. The resistance sense of prevention becomes self-protection rather than an obstacle imposed by an external adversary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An actor controls access or escape by shoving, restraining, trapping, fortifying, or refusing entry.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Social repulsion and withheld aid extend into battlefield resistance, hunting capture, defended settlements, and personal chastity.

parent_channels.name: Motion, Stilling, and Ordered Position

subchannels.name: Horse Race and Second Position
subchannels.scene_or_process: A horse is prompted from the muzzle into an extended run and takes a measured position immediately behind the leader.
subchannels.active_motifs: horse muzzle and lips (ط ع م:B009/m01); prompting a horse to run (ط ع م:B009/m02); extended run (م ع ن:B002/m01); second horse behind the winner (ص ل و:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Contact at the muzzle initiates motion, the run opens distance, and the second horse receives a position defined by the leader's body. The scene combines propulsion with relational ranking.

subchannels.name: Slow and Interrupted Movement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving body twists or lags, then may halt and look back rather than complete an uninterrupted course.
subchannels.active_motifs: slow winding run (د ع ع:B005/m01); slow travel (ي ت م:B004/m01); animal run interrupted by a backward stop (ك ذ ب:B007/m01); cessation of movement (س ك ن:B001/m01); calm stillness (س ه و:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Twisting gait and delayed travel weaken forward progress before the stopping animal makes interruption explicit. Stillness is the endpoint of the sequence, while the backward glance gives the halt a directional reversal.

subchannels.name: Steering a Vessel into Stability
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel moves on flowing water while a rudder or stern element counters oscillation and establishes a stable course.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing water (م ع ن:B001/m01); ship's rudder or stabilizing stern (س ك ن:B008/m01); stability after motion (س ك ن:B001/m02); obstacle that redirects action (م ن ع:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
subchannels.synthesis: Water supplies the moving setting, the steering component resists unwanted deviation, and stability is the resulting state. Prevention here is functional redirection rather than simple refusal.

subchannels.name: Succession and Ordered Formation
subchannels.scene_or_process: One formed unit follows another in an ordered series, analogous to a second runner maintaining position in forward motion.
subchannels.active_motifs: successive formation (ط ع م:B014/m01); second position (ص ل و:B006/m01); extended forward motion (م ع ن:B002/m01); action without delay (ك ذ ب:B005/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Sequence is represented as close following: a second unit appears after the first without breaking continuity. The race image gives spatial form to succession, while prompt action preserves the temporal link.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement is prompted, extended, slowed, interrupted, ranked, or stabilized by a controlling mechanism.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 107:2 يَدُعُّ / ٱلْيَتِيمَ, 107:3 طَعَامِ / مِسْكِينِ, 107:4-5 مُصَلِّينَ / صَلَاتِهِمْ, and 107:7 مَاعُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A horse's muzzle, the second runner, a stopping animal, a ship's rudder, and successive formation all encode controlled progression.

parent_channels.name: Livestock Body, Reproduction, and Dependency

subchannels.name: Anatomy and Bodily Condition
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal's condition is assessed through its loins, lung, fat, and marrow.
subchannels.active_motifs: loins and tail flanks (ص ل و:B005/m01); lung (ر ء ي:B009/m01); pulmonary ailment (ر ء ي:B009/m02); livestock fat and marrow condition (ط ع م:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و)
subchannels.synthesis: External frame, internal organ, and nutritive tissue create a part-to-condition map of the animal body. The loins give structural form, the lung supplies vital function, and fat or marrow registers nourishment.

subchannels.name: Pregnancy, Milk, and Maternal Severance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Gestation becomes visible in body and udder, but milk may fail and the young animal may be cut off from its mother.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible pregnancy (ر ء ي:B010/m01); enlarged udder (ر ء ي:B010/m02); milk yield that fails to persist (ك ذ ب:B006/m01); motherless animal (ي ت م:B001/m02); productive milk yield (ط ع م:B005/m03)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ / يُكَذِّبُ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي, ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م)
subchannels.synthesis: Pregnancy is inferred from enlargement, and the udder carries an expectation of nourishment. Failed milk breaks that expectation, while maternal loss turns interrupted yield into a condition of dependency.

subchannels.name: Herding and Seasonal Resilience
subchannels.scene_or_process: A herder calls young stock through a grazing landscape where water plants and forage allow them to withstand the year.
subchannels.active_motifs: herding call and rebuke (د ع ع:B003/m01); summer water plant grazed by cattle (د ع ع:B008/m01); camel forage grass (ص ل و:B009/m01); pasture that prevents migration (س ك ن:B010/m02); youthful camel or goat resisting the year (م ن ع:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ (م ن ع)
subchannels.synthesis: The call supplies human direction, pasture supplies the feeding setting, and youth supplies the animals' capacity to endure seasonal pressure. Resistance is physiological persistence rather than conflict with another agent.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal life is read through anatomy, gestation, milk, grazing, maternal attachment, and youthful resilience.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ / يُكَذِّبُ, 107:2 يَدُعُّ / ٱلْيَتِيمَ, 107:3 طَعَامِ, 107:4-5 مُصَلِّينَ / صَلَاتِهِمْ, and 107:7 يَمْنَعُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visual pregnancy, loins, lung, marrow, failed milk, orphaned animals, and young stock resisting the year form a single husbandry horizon.

parent_channels.name: Inner Attention, Self-Deception, and Recovery

subchannels.name: Deliberation and Self-Exhortation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person considers a course, consults judgment, and presses the self toward increased action.
subchannels.active_motifs: opinion and judgment (ر ء ي:B002/m01); deliberation and consultation (ر ء ي:B002/m02); self-exhortation toward increase (ح ض ض:B004/m01); reason and prudence (ط ع م:B008/m01); capacity for action (ط ع م:B011/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:3 يَحُضُّ (ح ض ض), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م)
subchannels.synthesis: Reflection establishes possible action, prudence weighs it, capacity makes it executable, and self-exhortation supplies the internal push. The scene converts command from an interpersonal speech act into self-government.

subchannels.name: Inattention and the Deceptive Self
subchannels.scene_or_process: Attention leaves an obligation while the self supplies a misleading account of its own state or value.
subchannels.active_motifs: mental inattention (س ه و:B001/m01); neglect and shortcoming (ي ت م:B003/m01); deceptive self (ك ذ ب:B008/m01); loss of worth or responsiveness (ط ع م:B008/m02); attention and inquiry (ر ء ي:B013/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ / يُكَذِّبُ (ر ء ي, ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و)
subchannels.synthesis: Neglect is a withdrawal of attention, but self-deception obscures that withdrawal from the actor. The inquiry formula interrupts the closed loop by directing perception back toward conduct and consequence.

subchannels.name: Forbearance After a Stumble
subchannels.scene_or_process: A faltering person is called to rise while another overlooks the lapse and answers with a restorative blessing.
subchannels.active_motifs: restorative call to one who stumbles (د ع ع:B004/m01); wish or blessing to be raised (د ع ع:B004/m02); forbearance and overlooking another's slip (س ه و:B003/m01); prayer and blessing for another (ص ل و:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:2 يَدُعُّ (د ع ع), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و), 107:5 سَاهُونَ (س ه و)
subchannels.synthesis: The stumble provides the lapse, the call supplies immediate direction, and forbearance prevents the lapse from becoming permanent exclusion. Blessing completes the recovery by turning rebuke into a wish for renewed standing.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The inner self can deliberate and urge itself toward action, lose attention, deceive itself, or recover through renewed direction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ / يُكَذِّبُ, 107:3 يَحُضُّ / طَعَامِ, and 107:5 سَاهُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Exhortation shifts inward, while taste vocabulary supplies reason, worth, responsiveness, and capacity as faculties of self-command.

parent_channels.name: Truth, Pretense, and Reliability

subchannels.name: False Assertion and Attribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker advances a false claim or assigns falsehood to another, while judgment and testimony establish the contested truth frame.
subchannels.active_motifs: false speech (ك ذ ب:B001/m01); attribution of falsehood or denial (ك ذ ب:B002/m01); judgment and reckoning (د ي ن:B002/m01); certification in judgment or oath (د ي ن:B007/m01); attention and request for report (ر ء ي:B013/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Inquiry opens a reportable claim, denial contests it, and judgment supplies the setting in which claim and claimant are assessed. Certification or oath introduces the counter-operation of entrusting a speaker within that truth relation.

subchannels.name: Deceptive Surface and Public Pretense
subchannels.scene_or_process: A crafted appearance presents itself as more or other than it is, and public performance uses the same gap between surface and state.
subchannels.active_motifs: deceptive patterned cloth (ك ذ ب:B009/m01); deceptive action (ك ذ ب:B001/m02); ostentatious display (ر ء ي:B005/m01); outward appearance (ر ء ي:B006/m02); mirror (ر ء ي:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب), 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Pattern and color make cloth appear unlike its underlying state; ostentation performs the same operation socially. The mirror and the watching eye provide the apparatus by which the crafted surface is produced and received.

subchannels.name: Failure to Persist
subchannels.scene_or_process: An expected action or yield begins but breaks off before its promise is fulfilled.
subchannels.active_motifs: failed or cowardly charge (ك ذ ب:B004/m01); milk yield that disappears (ك ذ ب:B006/m01); animal run interrupted by a stop and backward look (ك ذ ب:B007/m01); slow travel (ي ت م:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 يُكَذِّبُ (ك ذ ب), 107:2 ٱلْيَتِيمَ (ي ت م)
subchannels.synthesis: Charge, milk, and flight each create an expectation of continuation. Their premature ending gives falsehood a temporal form: the beginning announces a course that the outcome does not sustain.

subchannels.name: Prompt and Resolute Continuation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor commits to movement and carries it forward without delay or retreat.
subchannels.active_motifs: resolute charge (ك ذ ب:B004/m02); action without delay (ك ذ ب:B005/m01); extended run (م ع ن:B002/m01); capacity for action (ط ع م:B011/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity initiates action, promptness removes hesitation, and extended motion demonstrates persistence. The resolute charge reverses the failed-continuation scene by aligning announced movement with completed advance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A word, surface, charge, yield, or motion is tested by whether appearance and expectation continue into actuality.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: False speech extends into patterned cloth, failed milk, a broken charge, an animal that stops mid-run, and the contrasting image of action carried through without delay.

parent_channels.name: Questions, Commands, and Calls

subchannels.name: Inquiry and Deictic Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker summons an addressee's attention, points out a referent, and frames a request for identification or report.
subchannels.active_motifs: attention and inquiry formula (ر ء ي:B013/m01); demonstrative pointer (ذ و و:B003/m01); interrogative compound (ذ و و:B004/m01); relative connector (ذ و و:B002/m01); possession and attribution (ذ و و:B001/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: The attention formula opens the inquiry, the demonstrative fixes a target, and relative or possessive linkage identifies that target through relation. Questioning is therefore built as a sequence of orientation, pointing, and specification.

subchannels.name: Exhortation and Prohibitive Command
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker attempts to move another person toward an act or stop an act already contemplated.
subchannels.active_motifs: exhortation toward good or food (ح ض ض:B001/m01); battle incitement (ح ض ض:B001/m02); imperative to take up or adhere (ك ذ ب:B003/m01); prohibitive command (م ن ع:B005/m01); coercive redirection (د ع ع:B001/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: Exhortation projects a desired action, the imperative presses immediate adherence, and prohibition blocks a competing course. Battle incitement and charitable urging reveal opposite practical ends carried by the same directive force.

subchannels.name: Herding Call, Restorative Cry, and Lament
subchannels.scene_or_process: A voiced formula reaches an animal, a fallen person, or a community in distress and attempts to orient the hearer to danger, movement, or recovery.
subchannels.active_motifs: herding call and rebuke (د ع ع:B003/m01); restorative rise-call (د ع ع:B004/m01); blessing to be raised (د ع ع:B004/m02); lament cry (و ي ل:B002/m01); disgrace and calamity (و ي ل:B002/m02)
subchannels.synthesis: The herding cry directs movement, the rise-call answers a stumble, and lament voices a calamity already present. Across the three settings, sound marks urgency and reorients attention toward an immediate condition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Directed utterances organize attention and action by asking, pointing, exhorting, prohibiting, calling, or lamenting.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The discourse frame includes demonstratives and relative linkage as well as battle cries, herding calls, restorative formulas, and prohibitive commands.

parent_channels.name: Fire as Comfort and Ordeal

subchannels.name: Hearth Warmth and Roasting
subchannels.scene_or_process: People gather near fire for warmth while food is exposed to heat for roasting.
subchannels.active_motifs: warming oneself by fire (ص ل و:B001/m01); roasting and burning (ص ل و:B001/m02); fire as a source of repose (س ك ن:B004/m01); food and tasting (ط ع م:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 107:3 مِسْكِينِ (س ك ن), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:4 مُصَلِّينَ and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ (ص ل و)
subchannels.synthesis: Fire creates a domestic center by warming bodies and transforming food. Its heat is welcomed and controlled, and the resulting comfort helps define the inhabited setting.

subchannels.name: Punitive Heat and Woe
subchannels.scene_or_process: The same heat becomes an imposed ordeal associated with ruin, judgment, and lament.
subchannels.active_motifs: exposure to heat and hardship (ص ل و:B001/m03); doom and destruction (و ي ل:B001/m01); lament and calamity (و ي ل:B002/m01); judgment and recompense (د ي ن:B002/m01)
subchannels.synthesis: Controlled warmth becomes uncontrolled exposure, and the hearth's sustaining function reverses into suffering. Judgment supplies the cause-and-consequence frame, while woe voices the resulting destruction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Contact with fire can sustain domestic life through warmth and cooking or consume the sufferer as punitive heat.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 107:3 طَعَامِ / مِسْكِينِ, 107:4 وَيْلٌ / مُصَلِّينَ, and 107:5 صَلَاتِهِمْ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The prayer root opens both the hearth scene and the ordeal scene, while the dwelling root names fire as a source of repose.

parent_channels.name: S1. Filled Vessel and Lowland Catchment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Repeated agitation packs a vessel to capacity, while flowing water fills a low place at the foot of a mountain.
parent_channels.active_motifs: shaking a vessel until full (د ع ع:B002/m01); filled platter or valley (د ع ع:B002/m02); lowland at a mountain foot (ح ض ض:B002/m01); base surface for placing (ح ض ض:B002/m02); flowing water (م ع ن:B001/m01)
parent_channels.synthesis: Container and terrain share a form-and-capacity relation. Agitation makes a bounded vessel receive more material, while gravity makes the lowland receive running water; in both cases a lower enclosing surface becomes full.

parent_channels.name: S2. Dream Images in Flowing Sequence
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Dream images appear one after another with the continuity and movement of visible running water.
parent_channels.active_motifs: dream vision (ر ء ي:B003/m01); successive formation (ط ع م:B014/m01); flowing visible water (م ع ن:B001/m01); sensory sight (ر ء ي:B001/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 107:1 أَرَءَيْتَ and 107:6 يُرَآءُونَ (ر ء ي), 107:3 طَعَامِ (ط ع م), 107:7 مَاعُونَ (م ع ن)
parent_channels.synthesis: The dream supplies the perceptual setting, successive formation supplies temporal order, and running water supplies the motion analogy. The resulting channel treats imagination as a visible sequence whose forms continuously replace one another.

parent_channels.name: S3. Spirit-Mediated Divination and Healing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A spirit familiar appears to a person and discloses divinatory or healing knowledge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: appearing spirit familiar (ر ء ي:B008/m01); divinatory or healing disclosure (ر ء ي:B008/m02)
parent_channels.synthesis: The familiar is the mediating agent, appearance establishes contact, and disclosed divination or medicine is the outcome. Vision functions here as an encounter that transfers otherwise inaccessible knowledge.
